lines.zh: 我飘着往前挪，翼膜张开。
lines.en: I drift forward with my wings spread.
My body is smaller than it looks.
I do not flap; the air carries me.
I circle a basalt column.
My shadow flutters on the ground.
I drift, pause, then drift on.

lines.zh: 我从灵魂沙的缝里穿过去。
lines.en: I slip between the soul sand gaps.
My wings make no sound.
I move through the grey smoke.
I pause, then dart forward.
I go around a lava pool.
I travel along the canyon wall.
I sink low, then rise again.
Grey smoke shows through me.
I trail a faint wisp.
I squeeze out of the rock seam.
I drift along under the rock ceiling.
My wing membranes beat softly.
It is all ash and smoke here.

lines.zh: 我在灰烟里挑一个落脚处。
lines.en: I pick a perch in the grey smoke.
My body is cold.
There is heat under the basalt.
I hover, membranes beating slowly.
My outline is a little blurred.
Soul sand steams beneath me.
I wait for something living.
I fold my wings in to cover myself.
I count the cracks in the wall.

lines.zh: 你的脉搏在颈侧跳得快。
lines.en: Your pulse beats fast at your neck.

lines.zh: 我在数你有几处活的热气。
lines.en: I count the warm living places on you.
I am far quicker than I look.
You stand out too brightly in this canyon.
My mouth is small, and I am hungry.
You step back and I rise a little.
I know the warmth of the living.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，照不到我。
lines.en: That light in your hand cannot reach me.
I come from the soul sand.
I hear your breathing.
I am split and close again.
A corner of my outline is sheared away.
I retreat a little.
It hurts, and I have no flesh.
A hole has opened in my wing.
You scattered half of me.

lines.zh: 我散开的身子重新拉长。
lines.en: My scattered body draws itself long again.
Your hands are quick.

lines.zh: 这一下让我明白你的位置。
lines.en: That told me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 这点伤只让我薄了一指。
lines.en: This wound only thinned me by a finger's width.
That warmth draws me over.
What you hold is alive.
I sink slowly, closer.
I cannot resist that warmth.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子去够那点热。
lines.en: I stretch my neck toward that warmth.
That warmth has not faded; good.
You are shaking; stop.
I do not eat; I draw out.
That is not enough to fill me.
I am right against you now.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我像烟一样分开。
lines.en: At this bump I part like smoke.
The bump pushes me back, then I return.

lines.zh: 这一撞像撞到一层冷雾。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting cold mist.
My wing sweeps across your face.
You carry light; don't press close.
We passed half a body apart.

lines.zh: 我挨着你的肘弯掠过去。
lines.en: I sweep past, grazing the crook of your elbow.

lines.zh: 这一碰让你打了个寒战。
lines.en: The touch made you shiver.
I drift back half a foot and keep hovering.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞散了我的心口。
lines.en: Your shoulder scatters my chest.
I was born out of souls.
I only drain; I do not pair.

lines.zh: 这峡谷里没有第二个我。
lines.en: There is no second me in this canyon.
You ask too lightly.
I lean aside and say nothing.

lines.zh: 那种事要血肉，我只有影。
lines.en: That needs flesh; I have only shadow.
There is only wind passing through me.

lines.zh: 我只想吸走你身上的热气。
lines.en: I only want to draw the heat out of you.
I turn one full circle.
Do not raise that again.
I dip and take it in my mouth.
It has no weight in my mouth.
It slowly dries out.
I hold it inside my body.

lines.zh: 我尝不出这东西是死是活。
lines.en: I cannot taste whether this thing is alive.
I spit it out onto the ground.
My shadow covers it.
I nudge it over with a wingtip.
This is not food.
Keep it; I will look later.

lines.zh: 你的靴子碾过碎石，我听见了。
lines.en: Your boot ground on gravel; I heard it.
The canyon's warmth points to you.
I rise from the depths of the canyon.

lines.zh: 这一片只有你一个活的。
lines.en: You are the only living thing here.
I have begun my dash.

lines.zh: 我的下颚脱开，张到最大。
lines.en: My jaw unhinges and opens wide.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气像一盏灯。
lines.en: Your warmth is like a lamp.
I come around the basalt column.
The heat is thickest at the nape of your neck.
The first meal tonight.

lines.zh: 我把翼收到身侧，准备冲。
lines.en: I tuck my wings to my sides and ready my dash.

lines.zh: 你的火把在抖，我看得清楚。
lines.en: Your torch is shaking; I see it clearly.
My shadow reaches you first.
Good; you are mine.
I follow along the canyon wall.

lines.zh: 你跑过灵魂沙，脚步拖慢了。
lines.en: You cross the soul sand and slow.
I am a little faster than you.
I am just above your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你跑过三步，我追近一步。
lines.en: You run three steps; I close one.
The sound of my wings is faint.
This canyon has no branches.
I wait for your torch to die.
Your warmth is bleeding away.
I have worked around downwind.
I want to hear you call out.
I am nearly behind you.
Your shadow leans toward me.
One more step and I dive.

lines.zh: 我撞在你背上，吸了一口。
lines.en: I strike your back and draw once.

lines.zh: 你感觉像被抽走了什么。
lines.en: You feel something leave you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划开你的衣料。
lines.en: My claws open your cloth.
I pull back and hover.

lines.zh: 你挥了一剑，我散了一下。
lines.en: You swing and I scatter for a moment.
I re-form, closer.
That did not carry much force.
The colour has left your face.
I dive in again from above the flank.
You retreat; I rise after you.

lines.zh: 我从玄武岩峡谷的烟里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the basalt canyon's smoke.
At first I am a thin shadow.
Soul sand steams beneath me.
This stretch of canyon is mine to drift.
My wings open and close.
Nothing lives here, for now.
My body slowly takes shape.
I rise out of the rock seam.
A layer of ash settles over me.

lines.zh: 岩缝里传来脚步的回声。
lines.en: Footsteps echo from the rock seam.
The firelight scatters a layer of me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，散成一片影。
lines.en: I fall from above and scatter into shadow.

lines.zh: 水浸进来，我的翼都湿了。
lines.en: Water seeps in and my wings are soaked.
The blast scatters me and I re-gather.

lines.zh: 箭从我的影子中间穿了过去。
lines.en: The arrow passed straight through the middle of my shadow.
That light burns me white.
No living thing; I grow thin.

lines.zh: 雷把整段峡谷照亮，我无处躲。
lines.en: The lightning lights the canyon and I have no hiding.
I scatter into nothing; the sound remains.
